about_the_game:
UNITE and fight for the rights of wacky Inflatables everywhere by causing destructive mayhem through a campaign of protests staged across the nation. Flop and Flail together in a memorable righteous rampage.

INFLAMED is the winner of the Georgia Game Developer Association's 2024 "Best in Georgia" competition. Initially developed during the 48-hour Global Game Jam, Inflamed underwent an additional month of development to produce the BiG Submission downloadable demo, which is now on Steam for the world to play!

CONTROLLER RECOMMENDED!

  • Left Stick to Move

  • Right Stick to Flail Around

  • Either Trigger to Pick Up and Release

  • Left and Right Bumpers to Cycle Character Select

  • Right Special Button to Connect Controllers and Select Character

  • Left Special Button to Pause

Inflamed features a campaign where its Inflatable protagonists advance through a series of protests.

Each protest takes place at a unique location relevant to the plight of the unpaid Inflatables. In order to make a change and rally support, players will need to earn a series of symbolic victories, hurting bottom lines and garnering positive sentiment for the Inflatable revolution.

These symbolic victories take the form of objectives for players to complete at each protest - often requiring them to cause wacky and destructive mayhem. Players will need to work together to effectively complete their objectives and claim victory!
